name: Fake Layer Token Rug Pull
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.84). Replaced keyword guess "social-engineering".
rootCause: A scammer deployed a fake SOLAYER token on Solana, impersonating the legitimate Solayer project. Buyers contributed nearly $465,000 in liquidity, which was drained through a single sell transaction, causing the token to crash within three hours after a community alert. A malicious actor deployed a fake token contract imitating Solayer, attracted buyers who believed it was legitimate, then withdrew all liquidity in a single rug pull via a sell of ~17 trillion tokens, converting them to approximately 1,938 WSOL. The incident relied on Solana's SPL standard, which permits rapid token deployment without enforced verification or permission checks.
